    Request for Proposals (RFP) Archives

    Please refer to the RFP Archives table for all archived RFPs published between January 1, 2024 and September 30, 2025. Current and historical RFPs published on or after October 1, 2025 are found in the Vendor Self-Service System (VSS).

    Please refer to the Older Archives table for archived RFPs published prior to December 31, 2023.

    The tables below may be sorted by clicking on the arrows next to the column headers and using the Search bar. A copy of the RFP and any related documents (Q&A Summary, Amendments, Selection Packages) may be obtained by clicking on the links associated with the RFP.
